purpose: Add a non-circular J-Space interface-identification and training-evaluation condition that distinguishes current-output agreement from reusable future causal equivalence. This is research/method input only and creates no positive J-Space label, canonical dataset admission, runtime credit or training credit.

novelty_and_dedup.repository_search_result: No current file or open Trigger-2 PR was found for forked-future/future-consumer causal-interface equivalence before this write.
novelty_and_dedup.relationship: Cross-cutting acceptance law for future J-Space interface claims and integrated Hyperposition training/evaluation.

external_method_inputs.title: Hidden APIs in Language Models: Discovering Reusable Causal Interfaces from Forked Futures
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: Equal current answers can hide states with different future computational behavior; compare states using held-out future-operation response signatures and separate sufficiency, selective transplantation/locality, and mediation.

external_method_inputs.title: Steering Vector Fields for Context-Aware Inference-Time Control in Large Language Models
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: Static steering directions can be context-sensitive and can reverse or degrade on subsets; global-vector success should not be assumed context invariant.

external_method_inputs.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_method_inputs.supported_method_claim: Observed training can pass through shallow heuristics before systematic variable-binding mechanisms; remapped and compositional evaluation is needed before claiming systematic binding.

operational_equivalence_candidate.name: FUTURE_CONSUMER_EQUIVALENCE/v1
operational_equivalence_candidate.definition: For exact model/runtime identity M and a frozen consumer bank B, two candidate states are interface-equivalent only if their preregistered future-response signatures remain within family-specific tolerances across held-out consumers and required causal controls. Current emitted text is not the equivalence key.
required_controls: lesion/shuffle/rescue or causally equivalent mediation control when feasible
operational_equivalence_candidate.promotion_fence: No positive J-Space vector/subspace/interface label from decodability, current-answer agreement, average steering success, textual recurrence, workspace recurrence or model self-report alone.

hyperposition_integration.resolution_rule: Only exact-model held-out future-consumer signatures plus preregistered causal controls may discriminate these alternatives; majority vote or output similarity cannot resolve them.
hyperposition_integration.training_role: Teach preservation and test selection before collapse, not a preferred architecture label.

harness_feedback: Report consumer-family worst-case alongside mean fidelity/control.
Separate readout sufficiency from transplantation/selective control and natural mediation.
Cross context, remapping, layer/subspace and future-consumer family before generalizing one J-Space direction.
Keep exact model/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and state-tap identity in every causal receipt.
falsifiers: If exact-model states with identical current output also have stable equivalent held-out future signatures across preregistered consumer families and causal controls, the semantic-collision concern is not active for that tested scope.
If a single static vector is context invariant under preregistered cross-context, off-target and long-horizon controls, context-conditioned steering is unnecessary for that tested scope.
If a simpler Local/Mixture/Distributed candidate has lower held-out causal description cost or better matched-capacity fidelity than Shared, do not force a shared-interface interpretation.
next_exact_action: After exact Qwen3.5-0.8B state taps and model/runtime binding exist, freeze a small future-consumer bank before evaluation; generate paired semantic-collision and lexical-nuisance cases; measure held-out future signatures and matched causal controls; only then consider any positive J-Space interface label.
